licam integritatem credi cupiebat,

patere tantis Hereticorum erroribus potuerint Nemo miretur. Nam il-
lud vicium non ex inconstantia Sacri canonis: qui per se certissimus est,
Sed malorum hominum prauitate accidit. Sicut enim mundis omnia mun-
da sunt ita immūdis et infidelibus, quorū polluta sunt et mens et cōscientia.

# DE EVCHARISTIAE SACRAMENTO CONTRA

Non habere fundamentum in verbis domini. Attamen Christus dixit,
Hoc est Corpus meum, Hic est Sāguis meus, Nulle ibi similitūdines sunt
Nulle figure & parabole, Vere res ibi proponuntur & pura verba, direc-

teger verus deus & homo preter id ut species sacramenti in animam quoque
racionalem atque ipsam eciam diuinitatem transmutentur. Quia denique Christus
semel mortuus est & fuit corpus sine sanguine & sine corpore sanguis & utra-
que sine anima. & anima sine utrisque, Nunc quod resurrexit & iam non moritur
Et mors illi ultra non dominabitur, suntque corpus & sanguis eius in Sacramen-
to, est necessario pro Christi immortalitate ibidem illa vitalis porcio animae
Est quoque ibi diuinitas quoniam semel assumpsit naturam humanam
deinceps non deponit, Manetque Christus deus & homo in omnia secula se-
culorum. Et haec alia racio est vni anima & diuinitas veniunt in Sacramen
tum Alia inquit est ab illis portentis quae ad nostram sequi confessionem pig-

potuit, & catholicam ab illis fidem infamare. Et ego non miror si talis sit Pig-

breuissimam guttulam, ut quidem est. dixissent, Statim racio occurrisset,

& ego. Monstra illa quae hic Pighardus profert vere fieri nunquam possunt, &

->*F. Geldner*<-
->(Dr. F. Geldner), ORBR<-

--- Page 414 ---
<language>English</language>
<page-type>text</page-type>
<header>LIBRARY OF HARVARD UNIVERSITY
CAMBRIDGE, MASSACHUSETTS
THE HOUGHTON LIBRARY</header>

->6 August 1965<-

Mr. Herbert Reichner
Stockbridge, Massachusetts

Dear Mr. Reichner,

After another look at our copy of Ziegler it is now clear to me that the copy you have taken is correctly bound and complete in the first gathering and that the copy we have retained is also complete but is misbound.

The first gathering consists of six leaves, and it can be seen that all pairs are conjugate. If ours were correctly bound the order of contents would be exactly the same as yours. I believe as you do that Schottenloher has somehow confused matters in his description. But there may well be another issue with an errata list printed on one of the pages that is blank in your copy and ours. I shall be interested to hear what you learn of the copies in other libraries.

Very truly yours,

W. H. Bond <note>Handwritten signature</note>

W. H. Bond
Librarian

WHB:pao

<meta>Faint watermark in paper reads: CRANE'S DISTAFF BOND / MADE IN U.S.A. / 100% RAG CONTENT</meta>
<vocab>Herbert Reichner, W. H. Bond, Ziegler, Schottenloher, gathering, conjugate, errata, Houghton Library</vocab>
